IGUI_RestAndResume_Enabled: Rest and resume when out of breath
IGUI_RestAndResume_Enabled_tooltip: When exercise, tree chopping or an AreaTasks job stops because your endurance ran out, sit down, rest and start the same work again.
IGUI_RestAndResume_RecoverPct_tooltip: Stand up and resume when endurance reaches this value.
IGUI_RestAndResume_ZombieRange: Stop resting when a zombie is within (tiles)
IGUI_RestAndResume_ZombieRange_tooltip: A zombie you can see within this distance, or any zombie within 5 tiles (seen or not), cancels the rest, and you stand up.
IGUI_RestAndResume_MaxRepeats: Resume at most (times in a row)
IGUI_RestAndResume_MaxRepeats_tooltip: How many times the same work is resumed in a row before giving up.
IGUI_RestAndResume_MoodleLimit_tooltip: Hungry, thirsty, tired or injured moodle above this level cancels the rest (0 = any moodle). Pain from muscle stiffness does not; exercise is not restarted above pain level 3, as in vanilla.
IGUI_RestAndResume_ShowText_tooltip: Short messages when resting starts, is cancelled or the work resumes.
IGUI_RestAndResume_RestOnly_tooltip: Other actions that stop at the last endurance level: sit down and rest, without resuming.
IGUI_RestAndResume_Moodle: Not fit to continue - resume cancelled
IGUI_RestAndResume_ContinueOnTimeUp: Continue exercise when its time runs out
IGUI_RestAndResume_ContinueOnTimeUp_tool: When an exercise ends because its time ran out, start the same exercise again for the same time. Rests first if you are out of breath. Not when you stopped it yourself.
IGUI_RestAndResume_MaxLoops: Continue at most (times in a row)
IGUI_RestAndResume_MaxLoops_tooltip: How many times an exercise is started again after its time ran out. Counted separately from resumes after resting.
